selected.why: the cuTile/Triton ranking reverses between B200 and GH200; dynamic TMA bytes and shared-memory store counts differ by device; MI300X lowers the same TensorDescriptor source to 32-bit pointer loads (static ISA) with a diagnostic pointer-load variant
caveats: Triton reads a transposed B copy prepared outside the timed region; cuTile loads B as [K, N]
cuTile winner tile differs (256x256x64 on B200, 128x128x32 on GH200) and cuda-tile differs (1.3.0 vs 1.5.0)

selected.why: identical store sectors but 16x more (byte-wide) store instructions and ~17x more instructions for cuTile on both NVIDIA devices; Triton keeps 128-bit stores on NVIDIA but compiles to per-lane byte stores on MI300X (static ISA)
caveats: the PyTorch baseline (ATen index_copy) differs between vendors

selected.why: TileLang touches 7-10x more L1 load sectors than Triton with the same 16-bit load width and DRAM traffic, at lower occupancy and issue activity; on MI300X Triton's speedup rises because the PyTorch baseline runs MIOpen implicit GEMM plus layout transposes
caveats: TileLang uses a different kernel body on Hopper
the MI300X change is a baseline (PyTorch path) effect

not_selected.weight_dequant/bf16: GH200 Triton instruction inflation is attributable to a different autotuned winner (config effect, not architecture); kept for Figure A5 as a confounder example
not_selected.block_sparse_attention/fp16: moved to the appendix (A3 execution paths); evidence kept as 'supporting' rows
not_selected.flash_decode/fp32: moved to the appendix (A5 instruction expansion); evidence kept as 'supporting' rows
not_selected.vector_add/fp32: moved to the appendix (A5 MI300X load policy); evidence kept as 'supporting' rows

selection_rules: three distinct mechanisms (matrix operand delivery, indexing overhead, memory access and latency hiding), not the three largest speedup gaps
formal latency only (benchmark_cases_normalized) at the SAME case_id_v2 that the profiles captured
full (not reduced) NCU reports for every NVIDIA DSL shown, plus MI300X static ISA or kernel trace
each case shows a change across devices (RQ2), with its confounders stated
